recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16029; future changes to capabilitystatement-expectation contexts should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-16029 was a Published FHIR-core Change Request with a Persuasive resolution asking to add CapabilityStatement.rest.searchParam to the capabilitystatement-expectation extension context for requirements CapabilityStatements.
initial_application: The Jira comments record application in SVN revision 13953. No Jira-keyed Git commit for FHIR-16029 was found, but Git-era core imports of the historical extension definition included CapabilityStatement.rest.searchParam, and the context was still present immediately before core commit dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from the R5 source.
additional_context: The capabilitystatement-expectation StructureDefinition has moved out of the FHIR core checkout and is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. Current core pages link to the extension through the external extensions location. Later related decisions FHIR-20196, FHIR-46192, and FHIR-56196 changed the same extension context family but preserved the CapabilityStatement.rest.searchParam context relevant to this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The current authoritative Extension Pack source already contains the requested context at input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml:173, so there is no active core source file to edit for this issue.
